description.value:
The PuPu are small blue aliens of vast technological advancements, driven by curiosity and a devotion to collecting rare items.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: PuPu gain +2 Dexterity and +2 Intelligence.
  • Type: PuPu are aberrations (humanoids).
  • Size: PuPu are Small creatures.
  • Base Speed: PuPu have a base speed of 20 feet.
  • Languages: PuPu begin play speaking Common and PuPon. PuPu with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Sylvan.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Alien Mindset: PuPu gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, antagonize, confusion, and berserk.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Technological Savant: PuPu gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (Technology or Engineering) and Repair skill checks.
  • Technologist: PuPu gain the Technologist feat at 1st level.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: PuPu can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
